cases.question: What guardrails did Agentic Compass have?
cases.answer: Agentic Compass has several guardrails. Every remote write, including pushes, pull requests and evidence, is previewed and confirmed by the engineer [project-agentic-compass#6]. It never deploys, merges, changes traffic, flips feature flags, transitions Jira tickets or mutates cloud resources [project-agentic-compass#6]. Its permissions follow least privilege: the strictest child-skill guardrail wins, and the router never inherits the union of child permissions [project-agentic-compass#4] [project-agentic-compass#6]. Every material claim is labeled VERIFIED, INFERRED or UNKNOWN, and it keeps an append-only audit log [project-agentic-compass#6]. Its dashboard is loopback-only and read-only, with secret redaction and no write or execute endpoints [project-agentic-compass#6].
